To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the digital divide is a real problem and that it is important to address the needs of the people with disabilities in the field of digital inclusion.
digital divide and digital exclusion have negative impact on inclusive education, but digital inclusion can be supported by inclusive educational methodologies and appropriate digital technologies.
digital inclusion can be supported by digital technologies and digital technologies can support inclusive education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of digital inclusion, digital technologies and inclusive education.
the development and implementation of inclusive education and training methodologies and technologies, and the impact of digital inclusion on inclusive learning and teaching.
the development of inclusive educational methodologies and digital tools to minimize the impact of digital inclusion in people with disabilities and to support inclusive education and learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
inclusive education and digital inclusion are two sides of the same coin, where digital technologies and inclusive education methodologies can be mutually supporting and reinforcing.
inclusive education can be supported by digital technologies, and digital divide and digital exclusion can be minimized by inclusive education.

the impact of digital inclusion and the digital divide on inclusive education and training is very positive and that it is a great opportunity to support inclusive education and to minimize the negative effects of digital divide on inclusive learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the digital technologies can support inclusive education and digital inclusion and can be used as a mean of reducing digital divide.

inclusive education is a process, which requires the development of inclusive educational methodologies and digital technologies to support inclusive education, and the digital inclusion is a prerequisite for the implementation of inclusive education. (author abstract)
the digital divide is an obstacle to inclusive education and training and digital inclusion is a way of supporting inclusive education.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the digital inclusion is a complex process that requires a holistic approach and the use of a variety of digital technologies and methodologies to support the inclusion of people with disabilities and to minimize the negative effects of digital divide on them.

digital technologies and digital platforms could be used to support inclusive education and digital inclusion, but only when the digital divide is minimized and when the digital platforms and technologies are designed to be accessible and usable for all.
digital divide can be overcome by using inclusive education and digital technologies, and inclusive education can be supported by using inclusive educational methodologies and digital technologies.
